# Rutz

> Rutz is an AI running coach app for iPhone. It builds a personalized running training plan one week at a time from the runs you actually did, analyzes every run, and reshapes the week when you miss a session or travel. It reads your watch data through Intervals.icu.

Key facts:

- Category: running training plan app / AI running coach
- Platform: iPhone (iOS). No Android app.
- Status: private beta, coming soon to the App Store. Access is by waitlist at https://runcoach.net/#signup.
- Distances: any running goal from 5K to 50K, including 10K, half marathon, marathon and ultra
- How the plan works: the race date and training phases (base, build, peak, taper) are fixed; each individual week is written from the athlete's actual completed training. A load guard caps how quickly weekly training load can increase.
- Other features: written AI review of every run; chat with an AI coach that has the athlete's run history; pace, heart rate, efficiency and training-load trends.
- Data source and sign-in: Intervals.icu (OAuth). Any device that syncs to Intervals.icu works, including Garmin, COROS, Suunto, Polar and Wahoo. Direct Apple Watch support is in progress. Strava-sourced activities cannot reach Rutz (Intervals.icu may not relay them to third parties).
- Price: not announced. Free and premium tiers are planned, and how much AI analysis an athlete gets depends on the tier. The waitlist is free; inviting 2 friends who join earns 1 free premium month.
- Not offered today: Android app, guided strength / mobility / Pilates sessions, human coaches, multisport (running only).
- Languages: the coach replies in whatever language the athlete writes in.
- Design principle: code does the math, AI interprets the results.

- [Home](https://runcoach.net/): What Rutz is, how it works, FAQ, waitlist
- [AI running coach](https://runcoach.net/ai-running-coach/): What an AI running coach is, how Rutz splits exact calculation (code) from interpretation (AI), and what it should never do
- [Adaptive training plan](https://runcoach.net/adaptive-training-plan/): What stays fixed (race date, phases) and what is rewritten weekly; what the plan adapts to
- [Rutz + Intervals.icu](https://runcoach.net/intervals-icu/): How watch data reaches Rutz, how to connect, supported devices, Strava and Apple Watch caveats
- [Features](https://runcoach.net/features/): Adaptive weekly plan, run analysis, AI coach chat, load guard
- [Running training plan app](https://runcoach.net/running-training-plan-app/): What a running training plan app is and what to look for in one

- [Half marathon training app](https://runcoach.net/half-marathon-training-app/): Rutz for half marathon preparation

## Free running tools

- [Running pace calculator](https://runcoach.net/pace-calculator/): Goal finish time to pace per km and per mile
- [Heart rate zone calculator](https://runcoach.net/heart-rate-zone-calculator/): Five training zones and Zone 2 from age, max HR or heart-rate reserve
- [Pace charts](https://runcoach.net/pace-charts/): Hub for all race-distance pace charts
- [5K pace chart](https://runcoach.net/pace-charts/5k/): Finish times 15:00 to 45:00 with pace per km and per mile
- [10K pace chart](https://runcoach.net/pace-charts/10k/): Finish times 35:00 to 1:20:00
- [Half marathon pace chart](https://runcoach.net/pace-charts/half-marathon/): Finish times 1:10:00 to 3:00:00
- [Marathon pace chart](https://runcoach.net/pace-charts/marathon/): Finish times 2:30:00 to 6:00:00
